snippet.title: Cyberstorm arcade 1cc
snippet.description: A 1-credit clear of the arcade game Cyberstorm, played with WolfMAME 0.242. Score: 3,144,250. A very Atari prototype. GX-2's diving attack works really well! Another fighting game starring rock-em-sock-em robots - like Schmeiser Robo, Rise of the Robots, or the very solid Cyberbots: Full Metal Madness.
